resources.string: Eat a little less than you burn, so you lose fat at the pace you choose (0.25 to 1 kg a week). Protein goes up to protect your muscle. Pick it when dropping weight is your main goal.

Eat about what you burn, so your weight stays steady. With strength training it is also the recomposition option: losing fat and gaining muscle at the same time while the scale barely moves. Track your waist and photos rather than the scale.
Eat a little more than you burn to gain weight, ideally muscle, together with strength training (up to 0.5 kg a week). Pick it when you want to grow or are underweight.

Muscle: build size with 3–4 sets of 8–15 reps and 60–90 s rest.

Strength: lift heavier with fewer reps (4–10) and longer rest (up to 3 min).

Tone: lighter weights, 15–20 reps and short rest (45 s), for endurance and definition. Losing fat still comes from your calories, not from the rep range.

For goals that do not fit the options above, like losing belly fat while building muscle, training for a sport or working around an injury. You tell Coach what you want, it asks a few questions and proposes a plan; when you apply it, the plan sets your calories and your training. Until then the app uses Maintain.
